E-001.threat: Command injection: Attacker injects commands via data flow to escalate privileges in {{targetName}}
E-001.cause: Insufficient input validation in {{targetName}} — incoming data from {{sourceName}} is processed with elevated trust
E-001.attack: Attacker injects malicious commands or payloads into the data flow, which {{targetName}} executes with its own privilege level

E-002.cause: {{sourceName}} trusts response data from {{targetName}} without integrity verification, enabling privilege decisions based on forged responses
E-002.attack: Attacker modifies the response from {{targetName}} to include elevated roles or permissions, causing {{sourceName}} to grant unauthorized access
